annotations.title: Have one webhook link or fetch fill several sheets

description: One service, several sheets. Webhook links and scheduled fetches are the person's connections, not any sheet's: each fills a list of their sheets, each reading it with its own hacks, so the service is set up once (Stripe into a sales sheet and a budget, one Instagram token for two sheets), and turned off in one place. action list with no trackId lists every connection of theirs with the sheets it fills (never a fetch's address or token); with trackId, that track's own link and the fetches that fill it. add puts another of their tracks (alsoTrackId) on a connection: connectionId from list, or by the track it's on (trackId, with kind webhook for its own link or kind fetch with fetchId). remove takes the same and takes that track off; the connection stays, keeping its address. The other track only gets rows its own hacks read: turn one on there first (turn_on_ready_hack, use_community_hack or save_hack). Anything no sheet reads waits in the Inbox of the connection's first sheet. turn_on_ready_hack does this by itself when the service already posts to another of the person's sheets on another topic. Turning a connection off, replacing its link or removing it is the person's, in Settings, Connections.

alsoTrackId.description: add, remove: the other track, from list_tracks.

connectionId.description: add, remove: the connection, from list.

fetchId.description: add, remove with kind fetch: from scheduled_fetches.

kind.description: add, remove without connectionId: the track's own webhook link, or one of the fetches filling it.

trackId.description: list: one track's connections (leave out for all). add, remove without connectionId: the track the link or fetch was set up on.
